name: AWS Transfer Family
overview: AWS Transfer Family provides managed file transfer endpoints for protocols such as SFTP, FTPS and FTP backed by AWS storage.
examSignals: External partners need managed SFTP/FTPS access to S3/EFS: Transfer Family
Move bulk files between locations with scheduled sync: DataSync

compareWith.diff: Transfer Family exposes managed file-transfer protocol endpoints to users/partners; DataSync transfers datasets between storage locations.
